title: Jensen's Inequality · ELBO (Evidence Lower Bound)
prompt:
Derive **Jensen's Inequality** $\mathbb{E}[g(X)] \ge g(\mathbb{E}[X])$ for a convex function $g$, and use it to derive the **ELBO (Evidence Lower Bound)** in Variational Autoencoders (VAEs):

$$\log p_\theta(x) \ge \mathbb{E}_{q_\phi(z|x)}[\log p_\theta(x|z)] - D_{\text{KL}}(q_\phi(z|x) \parallel p(z))$$
